tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: List the local checks (audit_server_snippet, scan_secret_leak, rewrite_safe_curl). This endpoint cannot run them on text you send.

tools.name: sample_findings
tools.description: Show finding ids from built-in public fixtures. Does not read the request.

tools.name: install_local
tools.description: Return the local install file, its sha256, and client config. Optional client: claude-desktop, claude-code, cursor, gemini, codex.

tools.name: products
tools.description: Return the $19 and $39 kit URLs, the install page, and the registry remote. This endpoint does not read files.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_checks" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the local checks (audit_server_snippet, scan_secret_leak, rewrite_safe_curl). This endpoint cannot run them on text you send.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: products · Private data: install_local, products · Public sink: list_checks · Destructive: list_checks.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: products · Private data: install_local, products · Public sink: list_checks · Destructive: list_checks

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
